children: DexCom Chief Financial Officer Jereme Sylvain will take on the additional role of chief operating officer.
In his new role, Sylvain's responsibilities will include overseeing global operations and quality teams, as the company looks execute on its vision for growth, the company said Monday.
The biosensing-technology company said Sylvain, who has been executive vice president and financial chief since 2021, joined DexCom in 2018.
